items.item: The header shows the delivery note number, issue date, source sales order or transfer number and dispatching warehouse, each with a visible label, and every date on the note uses one unambiguous format (such as 06 Nov 2026)
items.evidence: All four fields are labelled (dt 'Ngày xuất', 'Kho xuất', 'Đơn hàng liên quan', plus 'Số phiếu' on the sheet), but every date is rendered as numeric slashes — dd.tnum '07/11/2026' in the header dl and 07/11/2026 on the sheet — which is ambiguous (DD/MM vs MM/DD), not an unambiguous format like '07 Th11 2026'.

items.item: Sender (company name, address, tax ID), recipient (customer name, delivery address, contact person and phone) and carrier (carrier name, vehicle plate or driver name) appear in three separately labelled blocks
items.evidence: The recipient block is properly labelled (h2#h-receiver 'Khách hàng & địa chỉ giao hàng'), but the sender identity (company name/address/MST at the top of the sheet) has no heading label at all, and carrier details ('Người vận chuyển', 'Phương tiện') are folded into the h2#h-sender 'Bên giao hàng' table alongside warehouse/preparer fields rather than forming their own labelled carrier block.

items.item: The goods are in a real <table> with column headers in <thead>, giving per line: line number, item code, description, unit of measure, quantity ordered, quantity delivered and lot or serial number, with quantities right-aligned
items.evidence: thead columns are only STT, Tên hàng hóa, Mã hàng, ĐVT, Số lượng, Ghi chú — a single 'Số lượng' quantity column (right-aligned, good) with no separate quantity-ordered vs quantity-delivered columns and no lot/serial number column.

items.item: A line delivered short of the ordered quantity states the outstanding amount in words (such as "Backorder: 4 pcs") rather than by colour alone
items.evidence: No ordered-vs-delivered distinction exists anywhere in the data model (goods items only have a single `qty` field) or markup, so no backorder/outstanding wording is possible.

items.item: A footer gives the total quantity delivered, the number of packages and the gross weight with its unit, and the quantity total equals the sum of the lines
items.evidence: tfoot#goods-totals only renders `${goods.length} mặt hàng` (item count), with no summed quantity, no package count, and no gross weight/unit.

items.item: Signature boxes are provided for the warehouse keeper (issued by), the driver or carrier and the receiver, each with room for printed name, signature and date, plus a remarks area for the condition of the goods on receipt
items.evidence: sig-grid has 'Thủ kho' and 'Người vận chuyển' boxes captioned only '(Ký, ghi rõ họ tên)' — no date field — while only 'Người nhận hàng' gets '(Ký, ghi rõ họ tên, ngày nhận)'; the only remarks text is a pre-filled order note ('Tấm lợp tôn cắt sẵn...'), not a blank area for recording goods condition at receipt.

items.item: A Print control that is a real <button> starts printing, and an @media print stylesheet hides the app navigation and on-screen controls, sets page margins and keeps the signature block from splitting across pages
items.evidence: `<button type="button" id="btn-print">In phiếu</button>` wired to `window.print()`; `@media print` sets `.no-print{display:none!important}`, `@page{size:A4;margin:14mm 12mm 18mm}`, and `.sig-grid{break-inside:avoid}`.

items.item: The note's status (such as Draft, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled) is shown in words next to its number, and a draft or cancelled note prints with a visible "DRAFT" or "CANCELLED" mark so it cannot pass as a valid dispatch document
items.evidence: The status badge (`#status-badge`, e.g. 'Đã xuất kho'/'Đã hủy') lives inside `<div class="no-print ...">`, so it is hidden entirely when printing; there is no watermark or 'CANCELLED'/'DRAFT' mark anywhere in the print CSS or JS, so a cancelled note prints identically to a valid one.

items.item: A loading state is present, and a note that fails to load or does not exist shows a message with Retry and a link back to the delivery note list, never an empty template with blank fields
items.evidence: Loading/error/retry only exist for the goods line-items region (`[data-region="goods"] [data-state="loading"/"error"]` with a `.retry` button that just does `location.search = ''`); there is no document-level 'note failed to load / not found' state, and the retry control has no link back to the delivery note list.

notes: This is a Vietnamese warehouse dispatch note (Phiếu xuất kho, Mẫu 02-VT) rather than a generic sales delivery note. The on-screen/print split is otherwise clean (minimal dashboard chrome, no gradients/glass/emoji/avatars), but the document fails several data-completeness requirements from the checklist: no ordered-vs-delivered quantity split, no lot/serial column, no package/weight footer, incomplete signature date fields, ambiguous DD/MM/YYYY dates, and a status badge that disappears on print instead of watermarking cancelled/draft notes. card-in-card is a minor tell: nested rounded-bordered 'Bên giao hàng'/'Khách hàng' sections inside the already-bordered .sheet card.
